local: measured on the machine that holds the transcripts; not re-run by CI

verdicts.claim: Import is faithful: for every transcript, the imported record holds exactly its main-thread tool uses, in order and by name, and one model call per distinct model request; and every imported record fits the strict schema (P0 passes).
verdicts.measured: 31 of 31 imports hold exactly the transcript’s tool uses in order, a model call per request, and fit the strict schema

verdicts.claim: The live path matches: replaying every transcript into the hook command gives a record whose tool uses are the import's, same names and same order; its log verifies line by line; and it fits the strict schema.
verdicts.measured: 31 of 31 replays: tool uses the same as the import, the log verifying, the strict schema met (3002 hook events)

verdicts.claim: Intent first, by construction: for every transcript replay, sealing the intent before the first prompt makes P1 pass on the hook record, and sealing it after the first prompt makes P1 fail.
verdicts.measured: sealed before the first prompt, P1 passed 31 of 31; sealed after it, P1 failed 31 of 31

verdicts.claim: Capture is cheap: across all hook events of all replays, the hook process takes a median of at most 150 ms and a 95th percentile of at most 400 ms of wall time on this machine.
verdicts.measured: per hook event (3002 timed): median 99.1 ms, 95th percentile 134.5 ms

verdicts.claim: The log is tamper-evident: changing one field of a line, removing a line, or swapping two adjacent lines of any replay's log is caught by the log check, for every such edit tried (up to 200 per log).
verdicts.measured: 2062 of 2087 one-line edits (a changed field, a removed line, a swap) caught

verdicts.claim: The recorder never breaks the harness: 500 garbage hook inputs (not JSON, the wrong shape, fields missing) each exit cleanly within 2 seconds, add nothing to any job's log, and leave a line in the recorder's error file.
verdicts.measured: 500 of 500 garbage inputs exited cleanly, silently, inside 2 s; jobs made: false; error lines: 500

verdicts.claim: A past job is never dressed up: every imported transcript, having no sealed intent, fails P1.
verdicts.measured: 31 of 31 imported past jobs failed P1
